pageAudits.currentPurpose: Existing broad national pilot-training overview and current intended national hub; it combines a newer sourced explanation of the training pathway with legacy course, pricing, scholarship, and promotional sections.
pageAudits.title: We One Aviation Academy | Pilot Training Institute in India
pageAudits.metaDescription: DGCA pilot training in India. CPL, PPL, ATPL and SPL courses plus DGCA ground classes. Free career counselling available.
pageAudits.mainSearchIntent: Understand the pilot-training/CPL pathway in India and how to access ground training, flight training, and guidance.
pageAudits.whatGoogleAndAIUnderstand: A national-intent page exists; the academy says it teaches DGCA theory, has a single classroom in Dwarka, offers online batches outside Delhi, and arranges flying through partners. It also links to Delhi, DGCA ground classes, and contact.
unclear: The clear delivery explanation conflicts with older course cards and promotional copy that imply a bundled or academy-delivered flight-training program.
The page does not consistently distinguish the academy's ground-school service from independently delivered partner flying-school hours.
It lacks a direct contextual link to /commercial-pilot-license, the CPL authority page.
The page's older commercial claims obscure the useful national pathway and the actual access available to students outside Delhi.
unsupportedOrRiskyClaims: A first-attempt DGCA exam success claim.
Scholarships up to 25%, scholarship/loan availability, and a 25% scholarship on a stated course fee.
Scholarship for every student, experienced/certified instructors, infrastructure/library claims, US-student claims, limited seats, and flight-training placement since 2009.
Old fee, duration, and India/abroad flight-training card details require current source and offer verification.
Broad aviation-industry demand/pilot-shortage predictions are not supported by the reviewed business facts.
pageAudits.geographicSignals: Accurately names one classroom location in Dwarka, says no classroom exists in another city, and says students elsewhere in India can join online. Other older city, US, and flight-training copy is less carefully bounded.
pageAudits.businessEntitySignals: Uses We One Aviation Academy identity and contact CTA. Article and FAQ schema are emitted; the shared EducationalOrganization is also emitted globally.
pageAudits.courseServiceSignals: CPL/PPL/ATPL/SPL and DGCA ground classes are presented, but legacy course cards blur theory coaching, course guidance, and partner flight training.
internalLinkingIssues: Add a direct contextual link to /commercial-pilot-license; the national hub currently links to /dgca-ground-classes and /pilot-training-in-delhi but not the CPL authority route.
Keep /pilot-training-in-delhi as the physical-city bridge and /pilot-training-in-dwarka as its specific address/detail destination rather than creating more city routes.
schemaIssues: Article schema describes a national authority article, but an explicit WebPage node and publisher reference to the stable organization @id would make page/entity relationships clearer.
Visible promotional and delivery claims included in the page/FAQ need reconciliation before being represented as current factual offers.
exactRecommendedChanges: Retain this existing route as the single national hub; do not create another national page.
Lead with the academy identity, one verified Dwarka classroom, online batches for students outside Delhi, and partner-delivered flight training.
Separate CPL pathway explanation from what the academy itself teaches, arranges, or does not provide.
Remove or substantiate scholarship, loan, pass-result, staffing, facility, seat-scarcity, and flight-placement statements before publication.
Reconcile every course fee/duration/mode card with current owner-approved facts and identify partner-school charges as separate where applicable.
Add a contextual CPL authority link and preserve the existing DGCA, Delhi, and contact links.

nationalArchitectureAudit.decision: Use the existing national route as the single national pathway and delivery hub. Do not create another national page or any city/locality/near-me route.
nationalArchitectureAudit.searchIntent: Pilot training/CPL in India, what the pathway entails, which portions We One Aviation provides, and how students in and outside Delhi access those services.
nationalArchitectureAudit.currentCapability: The page can serve this role because it already has national intent and contains the verified Dwarka classroom, online access outside Delhi, partner-school flight arrangement, and links to Delhi/DGCA course information. It is not ready to be the clean authority until contradictory legacy claims are reconciled.
requiredContentSequence: Identify We One Aviation Academy and define its education/ground-training role.
State the only classroom location: Dwarka, New Delhi.
Explain that students outside Delhi can join online batches without implying physical service locations in their cities.
Explain the CPL/pilot-training steps and clearly identify which organization performs each step.
Describe DGCA ground subjects and separately examined RTR (A) accurately.

Give application/contact steps for online students and in-person classroom students separately.
Link to the existing CPL, DGCA ground classes, Delhi, Dwarka, About, and Contact routes.
Answer FAQs about location, online access, academy scope, flight training location, eligibility, and application without city-name substitution.

nationalArchitectureAudit.canonicalStrategy: Keep each distinct existing route self-canonical on https://weoneaviation.in. nationalArchitectureAudit.currentMetadataAndIndexing: The shared Layout emits title, description, robots and self-canonical; default robots are index,follow with preview directives. The audited public routes are not deliberately noindex in their Layout calls. The served pages/robots.txt.js allows general crawling of public routes and explicitly allows listed major search/answer-engine crawlers. It does not establish ranking or index guarantees.

unsupportedClaimsAudit.evidenceAndReason: These are operational claims displayed on Contact/CTA surfaces but are not in the established business facts; confirm current staffing and terms.

entitySchemaAudit.localBusinessSchema: No LocalBusiness schema was found on the audited location/service pages. Do not add it for fictional locations or use online student reach to claim physical branches.

globalOrganization.fields: Name, legalName, canonical URL, logo, description, full Dwarka PostalAddress, customer-service ContactPoint, telephone, Delhi areaServed, email, foundingDate, and sameAs.
globalOrganization.assessment: Core entity and single physical address are represented. legalName equals the brand without legal-name evidence; contactPoint areaServed Delhi is not the same as online availability outside Delhi and should not be read as a physical service-area list.

sameAs.source: The global schema receives a sameAs array based on social URLs.
sameAs.assessment: Footer URLs contain tracking/share parameters while schema uses clean forms; the LinkedIn URL also differs (weoneaviation versus we-one-aviation). Confirm that each exact profile is controlled by the academy, then use stable profile URLs consistently. Do not assert ownership from a URL string.

entitySchemaAudit.address: Shared organization schema and business-location record agree on the Dwarka address, New Delhi, Delhi 110077. Delhi/Dwarka page schemas reuse the same organization @id.
entitySchemaAudit.telephoneAndEmail: Schema/shared facts use +91-9667370747; Contact/footer also use +91-9355566991. Additional numbers appear on airline-specific pages. Confirm roles and align schema and visible contact destinations. Shared email is info.weoneaviation@gmail.com; confirm Contact's decoded email matches it.
entitySchemaAudit.urlAndCanonical: Schema SITE_URL is https://weoneaviation.in. Layout emits a self-canonical from the path with query removed; www redirects to apex. No audited route requires a cross-canonical based on reviewed evidence.
entitySchemaAudit.courseSchema: DGCA ground Course uses a provider EducationalOrganization by name and URL and includes mode/duration, price range, and scholarship properties that need current evidence. CPL Course uses direct courseMode and an AggregateOffer/duration range that do not clearly distinguish academy tuition from the full partner-delivered CPL pathway. Course provider references should use the stable organization @id.
entitySchemaAudit.breadcrumbSchema: Layout emits BreadcrumbList on non-home, non-admin routes; the final crumb omits item URL per helper behavior. Ensure visual trail and structured trail continue to be generated from the same helper.
entitySchemaAudit.faqSchema: FAQPage is generated on audited pages and in shared page FAQ data. Answers must be visible, accurate, and synchronized; the DGCA India FAQ currently encodes broad online reach and scholarship claims.
entitySchemaAudit.nationalPageSchema: /pilot-training-in-india emits Article and FAQPage. Consider a WebPage node and connect Article publisher/author/provider references to the stable organization @id; no new entity or location should be created.
entitySchemaAudit.globalWebsiteSchema: WebSite is emitted globally. No Organization schema should be reintroduced in Layout as a second conflicting global node.

issues.issue: Organization legalName is copied from the brand name without verified legal-name evidence.
issues.recommendation: Confirm registered legal name from an authoritative business record or omit legalName.

issues.issue: Primary schema phone differs from the Contact page/footer number.
issues.recommendation: Owner-confirm phone roles and make visible contact points, schema, and WhatsApp links consistent.

issues.issue: sameAs social URLs are not fully consistent with footer URLs and the LinkedIn URL differs.
issues.recommendation: Verify control and standardize canonical profile URLs; remove unverified profiles.

issues.issue: Ground Course schema includes unverified price, six-month duration, and 25% scholarship property.
issues.recommendation: Retain only current documented offer fields and qualify what they cover.

issues.issue: CPL Course schema's AggregateOffer, 18–24 month duration, and blended mode blur academy teaching with partner flight training.
issues.recommendation: Verify values and express academy-delivered ground training separately from partner flying costs/duration.

issues.issue: Course providers reference a named EducationalOrganization but not the stable global organization @id.
issues.recommendation: Connect each verified course provider to https://weoneaviation.in/#organization.

issues.issue: The national page's Article/FAQ schema does not explicitly model a WebPage node and stable publisher relationship; page-level Delhi/Dwarka EducationalOrganization nodes repeat the same @id as the global entity.
issues.recommendation: When implementing later, use a coherent @graph or shared organization reference and keep visible page text/schema synchronized.

googleBusinessProfile.status: Profile ownership and current profile fields are not independently verified.
googleBusinessProfile.repositoryEvidence: A Maps CID link is present and prior repository audit records a We One Aviation Academy map result; this does not verify profile control, live NAP fields, category, hours, service area, reviews, or exact entrance pin.
requirements: Owner verify access and correct academy profile.
Check profile name, exact Dwarka address/pin, primary phone, canonical website, category, hours, and photos.
Do not add cities or neighborhoods as service areas absent actual policy/evidence.
Do not solicit or mark up fabricated reviews.

robotsAndCanonical.canonical: Per-page Layout self-canonical; query parameters are removed. www host redirects to apex per Next configuration.
robotsAndCanonical.robotsMeta: Default public-page value is index,follow with snippet/image/video preview directives unless explicitly overridden.
robotsAndCanonical.robotsTxt: The served pages/robots.txt.js allows public paths and explicitly allows named search and answer-engine crawlers, with exclusions for admin/private/API/data and selected parameter patterns.
robotsAndCanonical.risk: No route-level block was identified for these audited public pages. robots directives are access guidance, not an indexing guarantee.

recommendedRelationships.purpose: National pathway to course and verified local-delivery authorities.
CPL regulation/pathway to academy delivery and course details.
Course delivery to national access and the one physical classroom.
City context to exact academy location and national pathway.
Entity and scope explanation to actual service/location destinations.
Help prospective students choose the relevant service or national online access path.

issues.issue: National hub links to DGCA classes and Delhi but lacks a direct contextual link to /commercial-pilot-license.
issues.recommendation: Add one clear CPL pathway link from the national hub.

issues.issue: The national DGCA route does not adequately route readers to the detailed DGCA service page and the verified Delhi/Dwarka classroom pages.
issues.recommendation: Add contextual links; avoid using a city list in place of location navigation.

issues.issue: The CPL authority does not clearly connect the full pathway to the DGCA ground-class service and national delivery hub.
The detailed DGCA course page needs explicit upward links to the national hub and downward links to Delhi/Dwarka delivery details.
issues.recommendation: Add only these relevant existing-route links.

issues.issue: The DGCA course page has a Coimbatore anchor label pointing to /pilot-training-in-india, so the anchor and target do not describe the same page.
issues.recommendation: Correct the label/target or remove the link; do not create a Coimbatore route to preserve it.

issues.issue: About page explains academy scope but does not provide enough contextual routes to the national, course, location, and contact authorities.
issues.recommendation: Add a small set of in-context links, not a mass city-link block.

issues.issue: Contact page is conversion-oriented but does not distinguish online students outside Delhi from visitors to the Dwarka classroom through contextual service links.
issues.recommendation: Add concise course/online-access links and clearly label the one physical location.

internalLinkingAudit.navigationAssessment: Navbar exposes CPL, DGCA ground classes, and the national pilot-training route. Footer exposes About and Contact and the one address. Delhi/Dwarka routes are not prominent global navigation destinations; contextual links from the national/course pages are preferable to adding a large geographic nav.

evidenceReviewed: Existing site/domain references in first-party project content
domainAudit.conclusion: The available repository evidence does not independently establish that We One Aviation owns or controls weoneaviation.com.
domainAudit.actions: No recommendation to redirect, migrate, canonicalize, delete, or merge .com content. Do not modify either domain without independent ownership verification.

priorityFixes.fix: Remove or rewrite the /dgca-ground-classes-in-india claim of online and offline coverage across all 28 states; state the verified single Dwarka classroom and online batches for students outside Delhi.
Remove or substantiate universal state/UT coverage, city/state served lists, and '+ Every Indian State' coverage labels.
Resolve all scholarship, fee, loan, EMI, course-duration, free-repeat, free-material, and seat-availability claims against current owner-approved terms before retaining visible copy or schema.
Verify named flying-school relationships and distinguish independent FTO examples from actual current partners; never imply academy-owned flight operations.
Align DGCA syllabus language to five written papers plus separately examined RTR (A), and verify current exam-center statements against dated DGCA sources.
Reconcile the Contact/footer phone +91-9355566991 with the shared/schema primary +91-9667370747; confirm email, WhatsApp endpoints, legal name, and social profile URLs.
Clarify CPL and DGCA Course schema price, duration, mode, and provider scope; separate academy tuition/theory from partner flying-school costs and duration.
Keep /pilot-training-in-india as the single national hub and remove or verify its first-attempt outcome, scholarship/loan, instructor/facility, USA-student, limited-seat, and flight-placement claims.
Implement the existing-route link flow among national hub, CPL, DGCA classes, Delhi, Dwarka, About, and Contact; correct the Coimbatore anchor/target mismatch without adding routes.

After facts are approved, consolidate schema relationships around the stable organization @id, verify sameAs/legalName/contact data, and keep visible text, Course/FAQ schema, and canonical URLs consistent.

validation.note: This audit created only this report. The repository already contained unrelated dirty and untracked work before this audit; those changes were left untouched.
